messages:
Hannah (PM): Thanks for the all‑hands recap — quick follow-up for product/eng/sales: can we get a concise list of the top 3 reasons we won enterprise deals last quarter and the top 3 reasons we lost? Need concrete signals to plug into playbooks and presales.

Grace (Sales): Quick version from deals I'm on: Wins: 1) Dedicated capacity + SLA, 2) predictable cost modeling for large workloads, 3) VPC/KMS + privacy commitments. Losses: 1) total cost vs self-hosting for large infra teams, 2) lack of on‑prem package for regulated customers, 3) no first‑party tuning/fine‑tuning workflow in some RFPs. Will add examples.

Frank (CEO): +1. Also include "reference migration examples" — customers want a clear path from PoC to production with numbers. Can we quantify how often each ask appears in the sales cycle? Eng/Support, can you propose signal definitions?

Aisha (Eng): For signals we can instrument CRM + pre-sales forms: e.g., flags like `need_onprem`, `sla_required`, `peak_rps`, `data_retention_policy`. I sketched a query to count mentions so we can rank asks by frequency:

```sql
SELECT tag, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM crm_deals
WHERE created_at >= '2025-10-01'
GROUP BY tag
ORDER BY cnt DESC;
```

I'll run this and post the counts by EOD.

Carlos (Support): From support tickets, recurring themes are: "latency spikes during high load" and "quality regressions after model update". We rolled a KB but customers want product options (e.g., pin model versions, automated rollback). Those are strong churn signals.

Ben (SRE): We can produce a 1‑page performance expectations sheet (SLOs, tuning knobs, typical throughput on Dedicated SKUs) that sales can share. Also suggest exposing recommended autoscale/config presets.

Hannah (PM): Nice. Proposed plan: assemble a 1‑pager for sales + short eng checklist for Dedicated/Private pre‑sales. Owners: @Grace for sales content, @Aisha for signal counts and technical notes, @Ben for perf sheet. Due: next Wed. Can everyone confirm ownership?

Grace (Sales): Confirmed. I'll draft a slide and paste it here tomorrow. :thumbsup:

Aisha (Eng): Confirmed — will post the results and short notes tonight.

Carlos (Support): I'll upload three anonymized ticket snippets we can reference (latency, regression, onboarding friction).

ops-bot: note: doc created `playbooks/customer-insights-1pager` by @Hannah

Frank (CEO): One leadership ask: what's the single "ask we'd lose the customer over"? My vote: on‑prem/offline deployment for regulated finance customers. Does that match sales signals?

Grace (Sales): Yes — on‑prem + full KMS + audit logs blocked two high ACV deals last quarter.

Aisha (Eng): We can prototype an on‑prem bundle, but it needs a roadmap slot and security review. Happy to scope with Product.

Hannah (PM): Great — I'll coordinate with Product to scope effort and prioritize. Thanks everyone, I'll update the all‑hands notes and link the playbook draft when it's ready.
